issues.on_page: Line 24 Transfers Between Funds Out $10,000.00; Inter-fund Transfers From: Checking Account To: Certificate of Deposit
issues.issue: This is a move from checking to a CD within the same entity, not a transfer to another fund. The form treats it as an outflow, and line 29 Investments is blank, so the ending balance 33,099.70 probably understates total cash and investments by the 10,000 CD. Figures are kept as printed (the printed arithmetic holds); disclosed in notes
